key_concepts: The 5Rs of waste management include reduce, reuse, recycle, recover, and repair.
Waste management can help address flooding, ozone depletion, global warming, and air pollu
Reusing means using an item again or for another purpose instead of throwing it away.
Recycling means making something new from waste materials.
Old clothes and towels can be reused as cleaning rags.
Empty plastic bottles can be recycled into new objects such as toy helicopters.
Recycling conserves resources and helps protect the environment.
Organic waste such as vegetable and fruit peelings should not be placed in a recycling box
Some materials, like tissue, cannot be reused.
Newspaper and waste plastic foil can be recycled into bags.
Donating old toys or clothes helps conserve the environment.
Local recyclable solid and liquid materials can be designed into useful products.
